source: Static word vectors, contextual token representations, sentence embeddings, dense retrievers, Matryoshka vectors, multilingual spaces, and multimodal spaces are all variations on the same broad idea: learn a representation in which downstream structure becomes easier to compute.
zh: 静态词向量、上下文标记表示、句子嵌入、密集检索器、俄罗斯套娃向量、多语言空间和多模态空间都是同一个广泛思想的变体：学习一种表示，使下游结构变得更容易计算。
